dimensions.assessment: Affects the Shingle Springs Band of Miwok Indians and relevant federal agencies (Department of the Interior, Forest Service, BLM).
dimensions.evidence: takes approximately 265 acres of specified lands in El Dorado County, California, into trust for the benefit of the Shingle Springs Band of Miwok Indians.

dimensions.assessment: Transfers land into trust status, adds it to the tribe's reservation, and revokes a prior public land order.
dimensions.evidence: Public Land Order 3309... is revoked... Jurisdiction... is transferred to the Secretary... place the following land into trust for the benefit of the Tribe

dimensions.assessment: No federal spending, revenue, or economic impacts are stated in the source.

dimensions.evidence: To take certain Federal land in the State of California into trust for the benefit of the Shingle Springs Band of Miwok Indians

dimensions.assessment: Permanent trust and reservation status for the specified land parcels.
dimensions.evidence: The land taken into trust under subsection (b)... is hereby declared to be part of the Reservation

importance_detail.rationale: Takes approximately 265 acres of land in California into trust for the Shingle Springs Band of Miwok Indians and revokes a public land order, while explicitly prohibiting gaming on the land.
